label: prop:hadron-half-life
title: Hadron half-life from the $q$-deformed transition amplitude
html:
A nucleus displaced from the valley of stability (integer stability) undergoes beta decay. The substrate parameter q (substrate parameter) governs the half-life via the q-deformed transition amplitude.

Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be the Descartes universe with substrate parameter q, and let \mathcal{N}(Z, N) (stable nucleus) be a nucleus with proton displacement \delta p = p - p_{\mathrm{stab}}(A) from the valley of stability. The beta-decay half-life is

  t_{1/2}(p, A)
  = 
  \frac{\ln 2}{\Gamma_\beta(p, A)},
  \qquad
  \Gamma_\beta(p, A)
  = 
  \frac{|\mathcal{W}_2(q)|^2 \cdot \mu_0}{2\pi^3}
   \cdot 
  [2]_q
   \cdot 
  |\mathcal{M}_q|^2
   \cdot 
  f(Q),

where \mathcal{W}_2(q) = t_1 + c_{\mathrm{em}}\,t_2 is the weak vertex form factor of the mediating torus knot T_{3,5} (beta decay as crossing change) under the two-term Lagrangian trace: t_1 = \mathrm{tr}_{\mathrm{Markov}}((\sigma_1\sigma_2)^5) in H_3(q), and t_2 is the trace of the same braid against the connected all-pairs charge insertion with coefficient c_{\mathrm{em}}; [2]_q = q + q^{-1} is the \mathrm{SU}_q(2) fundamental dimension; |\mathcal{M}_q|^2 is the parent/daughter Markov-trace ratio; and f(Q) \propto Q^5 is the Sargent phase-space integral in the Q-value (transition energy). The decay rate depends on q, the dimensional scale \mu_0, and, through c_{\mathrm{em}}\,t_2, on the coefficient c_{\mathrm{em}} and the charges on the three vertex strands. When the three vertex strands carry one charge type, t_2 = 0 and the rate depends only on q and \mu_0.
